rubric.evidence: Re-verified ChromeStatus API 5863985044914176, whatwg/html#12263 (merged 2026-09-28), webstatus.dev customizable-select, BCD html/elements/selectedcontent.json, and live MDN <selectedcontent> on 2026-11-27. Confirms Chrome 150 desktop/Android/WebView ship for this edge-case fix, Safari 27 parent <selectedcontent> support, Firefox bug 1974276, and notes the MDN prose gap on multiple-descendant cloning and deferred updates.

Preserves stable route /v150/clone-into-all-descendant-selectedcontent-elements/, ChromeStatus identity 5863985044914176, demo: null binding, and exact listing H1 'Clone into all descendant selectedcontent elements'.

Retains all reference-contract.json selectors (#at-a-glance, #what-this-fixes, #syntax, #browser-support, #see-also) covering both edge-case fixes (all non-disabled descendant <selectedcontent> sync and deferred updates during DOM insertion/removal).

Explains customizable <select> context, clearly contrasts pre-Chrome 150 and Chrome 150+ behavior in a structured table, and explains why the change was shipped as a PSA rather than a full Intent to Ship.
Includes a semantic <pre tabindex='0'><code> HTML example demonstrating two <selectedcontent> descendants inside one <select> that stay in sync in Chrome 150+.

Documents Limited availability for the parent customizable-select feature (Chrome/Edge 135+, Safari 27, Firefox bug 1974276) alongside Chrome/Edge 150+ for this edge-case fix and Firefox/Safari No signal on the fix.

All reference-contract.json sources (ChromeStatus 5863985044914176 and whatwg/html#12263) plus HTML Standard, MDN <selectedcontent>, webstatus.dev, BCD, and Mozilla bug 1974276 are directly linked with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; zero plain-text citations or legacy host URLs.

Adopts shared /public/styles.css editorial tokens, /public/favicon.svg, logical max-inline-size on .table-wrap with visible :focus-visible outline, and verified zero horizontal overflow at desktop (1280x800) and narrow mobile (360x740).
No Chrome Platform Showcase demo exists for this behavioural edge-case fix; demo binding honestly remains null per durable-demo contract.
